name: Boston 168, 1000a, Tiago Fragateiro
description: This event features performances by Boston 168, 1000a, and Tiago Fragateiro. It takes place at Gare Porto in Porto.
longDescription:
The event "Boston 168, 1000a, Tiago Fragateiro" is scheduled for Saturday, November 14, 2026, at Gare Porto in Porto. The performances will run from 11:00 PM until 6:00 AM.

The lineup includes artists Boston 168, 1000A, and Tiago Fragateiro. The music styles featured are Minimal Techno, Hypnotic Techno, Acid Techno, Techno, Dub Techno, and Deep Techno.

Tickets are available starting at €10.00 for the first release. Gare Porto is located at Rua da Madeira 182, 4000-330 Porto, Portugal.
